context: Upjohn Business (a business unit of Pfizer, later combined with Mylan to form Viatris) condensed combined financial statements, Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filed 2020-08-06, note 'Revenues by Major Product and by Segment': the 'significant revenues by major product' table, USD millions, columns three months ended March 29, 2020 and March 31, 2019. The Upjohn fiscal quarter ended March 29, 2020 is mapped to calendar 2020Q1. This is the Upjohn Business scope, narrower than Pfizer's own worldwide Revatio line (2019: 136 here against 144 in Pfizer's series), so it is a continuation line and is never spliced onto the Pfizer series. The document prints the quarter as current. Revatio is not separately printed for 2020Q2, 2020Q3 or later quarters: the 8-K/A filed 2021-01-29 prints only nine months ended September 27, 2020 (67 against 126), so the two quarters together total 49 (67 less 18) and cannot be separated.
